tei:div.tei:p: spobs pa'i gter brgyad grol ba'i smon lam phan bde'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gi skye dang tshe rabs su// bla ma mgon po 'jam dbyangs kyis// brtse bas rjes bzung byin brlab nas// rlabs chen spyod pa rgya mtsho dang*// gzungs dang spobs pa'i sgom sgrub dang*// bde gshegs rgya mtsho mchod par shog /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// mtshungs med dge ba'i bshes dang mjal// mdo sngags bstan la thos bsam don// brjed pa med pa dran pa'i gter// ji bzhin rgyud la skye bar shog /zab dang rgya che'i chos rnams la// ma nor 'gal dang 'brel spyod pa'i// mtshungs med snang ba blo gros gter// ji bzhin rgyud la skye bar shog /mdo rgyud rnams nas legs bstan pa'i// don gyi rnam pa ma lus pa// legs par rtogs pa rtogs pa'i gter// ji bzhin rgyud la skye bar shog /sngon chad thos dang bsam pa yis// don rnams yid la rab 'dris nas// bskyud pa med pa gzungs kyi gter// ji bzhin rgyud la skye bar shog /gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa bzhin// pod rgyan ji ltar mtshams pa yi// dam chos 'dom pa spobs pa'i gter// ji bzhin rgyud la skye bar shog /dam chos rin chen mdzod lta bu// 'chad nyan sgom pa sun 'byin nas// rig pas srung ba chos kyi gter// ji bzhin rgyud la skye bar shog /dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs rgyun ni// mi nyams 'phel phyir sems bskyed pa// bla med byang chub sems kyi gter// ji bzhin rgyud la skye bar shog /theg pa rnams las rim bzhin du// zab las ches zab skye ba med// mnyam pa'i don rig bzod pa'i gter// ji bzhin rgyud la skye bar shog bdag gis 'di bzung snying po'i bar// zab mo'i spobs pa gter brgyad kyis// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba dang*// bde gshegs sras bcas mchod pa dang*// yi dam lha mchog mnyes par shog

/bla ma'i bka' drin 'khor ba dang*// bdud kyi dpung rnams gzhom pa dang*// rgyal sras spyod la rang byan tshud// rdzogs smin sbyang ba mthar phyin shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de sras kun// mjal bas mnyes byas chos nyan nas// 'gro ba'i phan bde bsgrub nas ni// bstan la bya ba byed par shog /mthar thug bla ma 'jam dbyangs dang*// dbyer med chen por sangs rgyas nas// gang 'dul sprul pa'i phrin las kyis// mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams don byed shog /tshul 'di dad bas bskul ba'i ngor// rmongs pa'i btsun chung snyoms las can// las kyi rdo rjes gang shar gyi// ri mo yi ge'i lam du byas// dge'o// ༈ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ/ rgyal dang rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po rnams// dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa// bar du mi mthun bdud kyi g.yang las skyobs// mthar thug rgyal sras thu bo'i tshul 'dzin pa// rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud// mtshan dpe lang tsho gsar pa'i ngo mtshar 'bar// tshangs dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i rgyud mang ngoms// mkhyen brtse shes bya'i rjes song nya rgyas dal// srid zhi'i mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' ste// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed bzhugs pa kun// mgon po chen po khyod kyi rol mo ste// bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// srid dang zhi ba yongs ye mi mnga' bar// thams cad stong pa de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings// don dam thig le nyag gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs// rang byung ye shes sems dpa' khyod la 'dud// ye shes thugs rje 'gro la rjes chags pas// gang 'dul 'gro la sna tshogs sprul pa yis// ye shes sgyu ma rol mo ston mdzad pa// lhag pa'i lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ oṃ madzñu shrī āḥ wa gi shwa ri muṃ/ dharma dha tu/ saṅga dzñā na garbha/ a hrī/ a i e o aṃ āḥ

ra ri la l̥ ye/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ mgon po khyod la bstod pa dang*/ rig sngags bzlas pa gang lags pas// skye dang skye ba thams cad du// mgon po khyod kyis rjes bzung ste// blo gros thogs pa mi mnga' bar// gzugs dang spobs par dbang 'byor nas// shes rab dri ma med pa yi// chos rnams lta ba'i mig rnyed nas// ye shes dri ma med thob nas// mthar thub bla ma 'jam dbyangs dang*// dbyer med mngon sangs rgyas gyur cig /ces pa'ang mchog sprul kun bzang nor bus nan tan chen por bka' phebs gser gyi me tog spyi bor bstsal nas bka' nan ma ldog tsam du shākya'i btsun gzugs ngag dbang dpal bzang gis bris/ dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
